about.title: About Checkpoint Retro
about.missionLead: Preserving the histories of games, creators, and technology that shaped the medium.

about.missionP2: We deliver thoroughly researched histories, unearth rare design archives, and celebrate golden eras from 8-bit to Dreamcast and beyond.
about.timelineKicker: From initial retrospectives to a thriving archive, preserving pivotal gaming heritage.

about.suggestDesc: Have an unpublished development lead, rare archive, or forgotten history? We'd love to hear from you.
